_comment: Dungeons whose boss room leaves the winners in a room of its own before the way out: a room
with no fight, where an NPC offers to leave. Winning the boss room loads that room on its
cell instead of the catalogue's exit, and leaving goes out through the dungeon's own exit
(DungeonManager.WayOut) -- from the NPC's exit replies or the map panel's «Salir de la
bossRoom  the room whose win leads here
room      the post-boss room, not one of the dungeon's fight rooms
cell      where the winners stand in it
npc       the NPC that offers the way out there
replies   his replies that leave; his others keep their own behaviour

exits.why: The goblins' Akademia: after director Grunob the winners are in his office, where «De joyeux petits arbres» has them ask for Gob Ross's brush («Une fois le donjon terminé, parlez au Directeur Grunob», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar la Akademia» leaves.

Moon's tree: after Moon the winners are at the top of his tree, where «Rendez-vous avec la lune» has them offer him the moon root («Une fois le combat terminé, offrez la racine lunaire de gisengoku au Moon», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar el Árbol de Moon» leaves.

Le Chuko's ship: after Le Chuko the winners are in his cabin, where «Squelettes et amulettes» has them order him to give the amulet back («Avant de sortir du donjon, parlez au Chouque», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar el navío de Le Chuko» leaves.

Kardorim's crypt (PR #75, 23 October 2026): the win in his room loads the post-boss room on cell 382; his four template replies «Quitter la crypte de Kardorim» (texts 555709-555712) leave; his quest and Milimilou replies do not.

The Haunted Mansion: after Boostache the winners are in the mansion's last room [-13,-41], which «Fantômes contre fantômes» asks to discover (4149), and the chafer host takes them out («reparlez au Gentil Organisateur Chafer pour sortir du donjon», Dofus pour les noobs); his two «Salir» replies leave.

The Kwakwa's nest: after the Kwakwa the winners are in the nest's exit room [-4,-7] («The Kwakwa's Nest - Exit»), which «L'Ascension» asks to discover (4329), and the Kwakerback host takes them out; his «Salir» leaves.

The Kanniboul village: after Kanniboul Ebil the winners are in the village's exit room [29,9] («Kanniball Village - Exit»), which «T'as les boules» asks to discover (4113), and the kanniboul host takes them out («reparlez au Gentil Organisateur pour sortir du donjon», Dofus pour les noobs); his two «Salir» replies leave.

The Lair of the Rac Queen: after Lasoberaña's fight the winners are in the lair's exit room [-6,-15], where «Arak-haï en pagaille» has her talk (9558); her «Abandonar la guarida de Lasoberaña» replies leave.

The Ancestral Domain: after the Ancestral Treechnid the winners are in the domain's exit room [-9,-14], where «Munster lève le mystère» questions him (9567), and Tronky Tranky takes them out; his «Salir del Territorio Ancestral» leaves.

The Soft Oak Clearing: after the Soft Oak the winners are in the clearing's exit room [-14,-13], where «L'art de la langue de bois» questions him (9581), and Josefa Taplana takes them out; her «Salir del claro» leaves.

The hidden laboratory's Exit room: «Vous voilà maintenant devant Jean Nauh» (Dofus pour les noobs) after the four fights; «Salir.» leaves (his «Aceptar y salir del laboratorio.» leaves through his tree, once it has done 969).

The last map of the Floribund Clearing, where Juana Morros hides: «Une fois tous ces monstres tués vous trouvez sa femme» (Dofus pour les noobs); her «Acepto.» leaves through her tree, back to the doctor on the branches.

Brumen Tinctorias's laboratory: after Nelwynn (the fifth room) the winners are in the laboratory's own way out («LaboRATory - Exit», 176952320), where Tassa offers «Salir del laboratorio»; reaching it is «¿Dónde se ha ido la 7.ª compañía?»'s 4555. Cell 330: open floor in front of the workbench, two cells from Tassa.

Thor Pestruz's aviary: after the fifth room the winners are in the aviary's own way out («Cross Strich's Aviary - Exit», 132912128), where Orno Tóligo shows the stairs down. Cell 328: open floor of the pen, two cells from him.

Dramak's Theatre: after the Puppet Master (Auditorium 5) the winners are in the theatre's Exit room where Dramak stands, and «Ainsi font les petites marionnettes» has them talk to him before leaving («Une fois le donjon terminé, parlez à Dramak mais ne sortez pas tout de suite», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar el Teatro de Dramak.» and «Abandonar el teatro con la sensación de haber cumplido con tu deber.» leave. INFERRED cell: two rows above Dramak's (399), on the stage's floor.

Sombra's Pyramid: after Sombra (Fifth Room) the winners are in the pyramid's Exit room where he stands beaten, and «L'armée des ombres» has them chain him there before leaving («Une fois que vous avez vaincu Ombre parlez lui et attachez le avec les chaînes au sol de la Pyramide», Dofus pour les noobs); his three «Salir de la Pirámide de Sombra.» leave. INFERRED cell: two rows below his (314).

Merkator's Aquadome: after the Treasure Room the winners are in the Aquadome's Exit room where Merkator stands, and «Pollution, je dis non» (Dofus pour les noobs) has them talk to him there; «Salir del Acuadomo de Merkator.», «Encogerte de hombros y salir del Acuadomo.» and «Darle algunas réplicas sinceras e irte.» leave. INFERRED cell: open floor a row below Merkator's.

The Wa Wabbit's castle: after the Wa Wabbit the winners are in the castle's Exit room («Castillo del Wey Wabbit - Salida»), where he sits beaten by his throne, and «Le château du Wa» has them talk to him there («Une fois le Wa Wabbit vaincu, parlez lui», Dofus pour les noobs); his two «Salir.» leave. Cell 326: the room's way in, across the carpet from him.

The Wa Wabbit's burrow: after the Wa Wobot the winners are in the burrow's Exit room («Madriguera del Wey Wabbit - Salida»), where the guardian of the carrot dofus stands by its pedestal, and «L'œuf ou la cawotte ?» has them talk to him there («Il vous faut finir le Terrier du Wa Wabbit pour parler au Gawdien du Dofus», Dofus pour les noobs). «Apoderarte del dofus zanahowia y escaparte.» and «Irte sin buscar problemas.» leave by the dungeon's own exit. Cell 282: the room's way in.

Lord Crow's library: after the master the winners are in the antechamber next to his throne room, where Natacha waits for his guide in «Voler dans les plumes» («Avant de sortir, parlez à Natacha Manka qui vous demandera le guide», Dofus pour les noobs; 11395's map) and Virgil's «Salir de la biblioteca» leaves. INFERRED cell, an open walkable one.

Kanígrula's cave: after the matriarch the winners are in the cave's exit room, where she stands beaten and «La risueña miaumiena» has them ask her for Pol («Une fois Kanigroula mise au tapis, celle-ci mécontente vous menace», Dofus pour les noobs, «Chachyène de vie»); her three «Salir de la Gruta de Kanígrula» leave. INFERRED cell, an open walkable one in front of her.
